verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it supports replication configurations as well as single-server setups, and lists Kubernetes as a supported environment. That is a direct but thin claim: nothing in the pack shows how to configure replication or achieve high availability, and no hands-on report confirms it. missing for 10: documented HA architecture and setup guide (shared storage, session and queue handling, multi-node configuration), explicit high-availability or failover claims, independent or hands-on corroboration of replicated deployments.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy a self-hosted instance in a replicated, highly available configuration

citations.quote: Provides flexible deployment options, supporting both single server setups and replication configurations.
Universally compatible with diverse operating systems and environments, including Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes.
